title: 4D-GSW: Kinematic-Aware Spatio-Temporal Consistent Watermarking for 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2605.22342v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has revolutionized high-fidelity dynamic reconstruction, safeguarding the intellectual property of these assets remains an open challenge. Conventional steganographic techniques often neglect the underlying kinematic manifolds, triggering non-physical artifacts such as severe temporal flickering and "FVD collapse". To address this, we propose \textbf{4D-GSW}, a kinematic-aware watermarking framework designed to embed robust copyright information while preserving high spatio-temporal consistency. Unlike prior 4D steganography that primarily focuses on opacity-guided invisibility, our approach explicitly addresses the physical coherence of motion trajectories. We introduce a \textbf{Spatio-Temporal Curvature (STC)} metric to identify "Dynamic Instants," adaptively gating watermark gradient injection to shield critical motion manifolds from non-physical perturbations. translated_title: 4D-GSW：面向4D高斯泼溅的运动学感知时空一致水印技术
translated_abstract: 尽管4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）已经彻底改变了高保真动态重建，但保护这些资产的知识产权仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。传统的隐写技术往往忽略了底层的运动学流形，会引发严重的时序闪烁和“FVD崩溃”等非物理伪影。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了4D-GSW，一个运动学感知的水印框架，旨在嵌入鲁棒的版权信息的同时保持高时空一致性。与以往主要关注基于不透明度引导的不可见性的4D隐写方法不同，我们的方法显式地处理运动轨迹的物理连贯性。我们引入了时空曲率（STC）度量来识别“动态瞬间”，自适应地控制水印梯度注入，以保护关键运动流形免受非物理扰动。为了确保全局连贯性……
tldr: 提出了一种面向4D高斯泼溅的运动学感知水印框架4D-GSW，通过时空曲率（STC）度量识别“动态瞬间”并自适应控制水印梯度注入，在嵌入鲁棒版权信息的同时有效保护运动流形的物理连贯性。
en_tdlr: Proposes 4D-GSW, a kinematic-aware watermarking framework for 4D Gaussian Splatting that identifies "Dynamic Instants" via a Spatio-Temporal Curvature metric and adaptively gates watermark gradient injection, embedding robust copyright information while preserving the physical coherence of motion manifolds.
